_comment: The one source of truth for the facts in Lumi's legal texts. packaging/legal_texts.py renders lumi/legal/templates/ with these values into lumi/legal/*.md, sdk/LICENSE, sdk/python/lumi_extension/LICENSE and lumi/code_editors/vscode/LICENSE.txt, and the installers' license pages. A value still reading [[TO BE PROVIDED: ...]] warns in pull request CI and fails a release build (RELEASING.md). Changing a document's version asks everyone to accept it again (lumi/terms.py); changing only its effective date doesn't.
